notes.title: Update Notes for 7/16/23
notes.notes:
Update Details:

[list]
[*] The first iteration of manual throws has been added to the game. For more details see the "Manual Throws" section towards the bottom of these notes (currently a selectable option in Dashboard Options).
[*] New swing meter for UI.
[*] Mild UI adjustments for manual throws.
[*] Delay adjustments for after each throw.
[*] Mild Title Menu Options adjustments and fixes.
[*] Minnow Park Disc Golf Park has been completely revamped with less trees and new lines.
[*] Other small bug fixes and updates.
[/list]

Learn More:

[list]
[*] For questions or comments regarding this release, please reach out to an Admin on the [url=https://discgolfgameon.com/discord]DGGO Discord[/url]
[/list]

Manual Throws:

The introduction of manual throws brings a whole new competitive feel to DGGO. Using the new throw mechanic is simple to understand but challenging to master. Simply press and hold the throw button to initiate the backswing. While you're doing this, you will notice a slider appear toward the right side of the screen. Once visible the slider’s handle will begin to follow the backswing animation and as a result move downward on the slider. Once it reaches the bottom, the slider’s handle will begin to move upwards in correlation with the player's forward swing animation. The speed at which the handle moves back to the top of the slider is determined by the Speed rating of the particular disc. As a result, slower speed discs are much easier to throw than their higher speed counterparts. The ideal time to release the throw button is right before the handle reaches the peak of the slider (this section is also denoted by two green squares). Releasing the throw button early will result in an “Early Release” causing the disc to be thrown more left (for RHBH). Releasing the throw button too late will result in a “Late Release” causing grip lock, which will result in the disc flying more to the right (RHBH).

If the player releases the throw button during the backswing (or much too early during the forward swing) the disc will return to its starting position. Those who have previously used the putting stance may already be familiar with this type of hold and release mechanic.

Manual throws will continue to be tested and tuned throughout July and into early August, at which point they will replace the current throws as the default throw mechanic. The current “Single Click” throws will also remain as an option for unranked or otherwise specified events. When this does happen, some or all player stats may be reset, including leaderboards to ensure fairness across all accounts.

Players are encouraged to provide feedback on the new manual throw mechanics throughout this and next month. As always, please feel free to join the DGGO Discord to discuss any questions or ideas you may have about the game (https://discgolfgameon.com/discord).

notes.title: Patch Notes for 4/23/23
notes.notes:
Patch Details:

[list]
[*] The camera shake frequency has been slightly reduced.
[*] Added OB to Cony Park and (for the first time) OB markers (the orange spikey things) to help designate OB areas.
[*] Small location adjustments have been made for some holes at Cony Park.
[*] Improved camera culling for Cony Park for increased performance.
[*] Fixed an issue with some baskets not triggering on Beachwood Park.
[*] Fixed an issue where some courses were missing a menu component and as a result the player could not conclude the round.
[*] Fixed an issue where at times music would still play in the player Dashboard area.
[*] Other small bug fixes and adjustments.
[/list]

Learn More:

[list]
[*] For questions or comments regarding this release, please reach out to an Admin on the [url=https://discgolfgameon.com/discord]DGGO Discord[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 4/22/23
notes.notes:
Patch Details:

[list]
[*] The camera shake has be added back to the game, making it harder to just line up a throw and click.
[*] The faster the speed of the disc and the harder the player is trying to throw it, the more the camera will shake during the players forward swing.
[*] The options menu has been added back into the game and can be accessed within the title menu screen. Some of the available options are still being added, but sound and screen resolution can now be adjusted.
[*] A bug that was preventing the player form purchasing discs in some cases has been resolved.
[*] Other small bug fixes and adjustments.
[/list]

Learn More:

[list]
[*] For questions or comments regarding this release, please reach out to an Admin on the [url=https://discgolfgameon.com/discord]DGGO Discord[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for 4/21/23
notes.notes:
Update Details:

[list]
[*] Players are no longer forced to select a bag when returning from rounds (or the main menu).
[*] Players will now load with the last bag they used/selected.
[*] Trees that were allowing the player to throw the disc through them have been replaced.
[*] A new 'Game Settings' menu has been added to the player dashboard. It's currently limited but more will come in future patches and updates.
[*] Players can now select the left handed option from the Game Settings menu. Game settings are now saved and will be loaded as default when the player returns (no more having to select left-handed before every round).
[*] A new UI has been implemented for the HUD and bag (more to come).
[*] Additions and small changes have been made to Beachwood park. Most changes are cosmetic, but some holes are slightly altered.
[*] Other small additions and changes.
[*] Other small bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for 4/19/23
notes.notes:
Update Details:

[list]
[*] New out of bounds locations for two courses: Shipwreck and Timber Peak Trails.
[*] Updates to Shipwreck, including lighting, environment, models and mild tee to basket adjustments.
[*] Updates to Timber Peak Trails, including lighting, environment and mild tee to basket adjustments.
[*] Disc impact has been reduced on both the terrain and the chains.
[*] Chains have been "softened/dampened" for less chance of a chain out (especially from strong side of the chains/basket)
[*] Other small bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 4/16/23
notes.notes:
Patch Details:

[list]
[*] The chains have been adjusted to lower the chance of a spit-out.
[*] Disc to terrain collision has been adjusted but still needs further tuning.
[*] Disc out of bound detection slightly improved.
[/list]

Learn More:

[list]
[*] For questions or comments regarding this release, please reach out to an Admin on the [url=https://discgolfgameon.com/discord]DGGO Discord[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 4/15/23
notes.notes:
Patch Details:

[list]
[*] Flex lock adjusted (prevents disc from getting stuck straight).
[*] Constraint has been rebuilt (player could previously move unrestricted if the disc hit a high enough obstacle).
[*] Disc stability and understable disc flight has been improved.
[*] Fixed the bug that allowed the disc to spin after stopping.
[*] Fixed 'e' key bug where it would move the player to an OB (sometimes under water) position instead of sending the player to a drop zone or back to where they threw from prior to OB.
[*] Other small bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for 4/13/23
notes.notes:
Update Details:

[list]
[*] Disc flight accuracy has been improved.
[*] The more understable a disc is, the more it will resist flexing out.
[*] Throw force and disc velocity now have a greater impact on flip/flex speeds.
[*] Understable discs now get slightly more distance.
[*] A confirmation box has been added for when a player chooses the option to rethrow.
[*] Other small bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for 4/12/23
notes.notes:
Update Details:

[list]
[*] Players can now play CTP on all Standard courses.
[*] A new drop-down has been added to the course confirmation notice. This allows the player to choose either Stroke or CTP play mode before starting the round.
[*] CTP UI has been slightly adjusted to better accommodate some elements.
[*] The basket look-at feature (after the disc stops) has been disabled for anything less than 20ft (previously 10ft).
[*] Players can now remove discs from their selected bag (Player Dashboard > Storage).
[*] A player can remove a disc from their bag by right-clicking the disc from within the selected bag (panel), or by right-clicking a disc within the storage (panel) that is already present in the currently selected bag.
[*] Other small bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for 4/11/23
notes.notes:
Update Details:

[list]
[*] Disc flight max distances for some discs have been adjusted.
[*] Disc flex speeds for some discs have been adjusted.
[*] Out of bounds has been added to courses containing water areas. Hole specific out of bounds is expected to be added in the coming week.
[*] The drag and drop mechanic for adding discs to a given bag has been replaced with a right-click mechanic. Click the bag you want to add discs to, then over in the Storage panel, right-click the disc to add.
[*] Bag coin bonuses are no longer percentage based and have been adjusted to provide whole number values instead.
[*] Bags that offer coin bonuses now award the coin bonus regardless of the player score after the round.
[/list]
